snippet.title: Sanctuaries - Trailer
snippet.description:
Sanctuaries is our new tower defense / Hero RPG game.

"The conquistadors just landed and they are coming for your treasure! Take arms, lay down traps, improve your empire and lead your Heroes into battle to repel the invaders!"

Sanctuaries on android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.spookygames.sanctuaries
Sanctuaries on iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sanctuaries/id1495168987
